description: Checks GDScript (and class names in C#, names in shaders) against name-only snapshots of the real Godot API (godot@3, godot@4.3, godot@4.7) plus the official 3→4 rename table. Reports: renamed-class/function/member/pattern (Godot 3 names in Godot 4 code with the Godot 4 replacement: KinematicBody2D, instance(), yield, deg2rad, string connect, export/onready without @), unknown-class/method/member (not in that version: a model-invented or misspelled API, with the closest real name), too-new (exists only in a newer version, or Godot 4 names in a Godot 3 project). Members are checked only where the receiver type is known (extends, typed vars, Class.new(), singletons, parameters with type hints); untyped receivers are skipped, not guessed. The Godot version comes from engine, else from project.godot, else the newest snapshot. Run it on every file an agent wrote before opening Godot.

content.description: Code to check instead of path.

engine.description: Target: godot@4.7, godot@4.3, godot@3 (or just 4 / 3). Default: project.godot, else newest.

path.description: A .gd/.cs/.gdshader file or a project folder.

name: re_apicheck
title: Check code against a real engine API
